workstream.title: PageKit / Class Player / whiteboard R07 recovery

human_intent: Execute recovery lane R07 completely: recover durable capability lineage for PageKit / Class Player / whiteboard across versions, including laser, whiteboard, Wacom/stylus evidence, curves, eraser, tabs and fullscreen; detect regressions without collapsing distinct owners; persist enough state that future agents do not need historical chats.
already_decided: This workstream owns R07 recovery knowledge and coordination only; it is not a replacement PageKit product owner.
Current/Catalog/Lineage authority remains external to this recovery workstream.
pagekit-v26 is the stable-class-player rollback donor / positive rollback fossil in Lineage.
pagekit-v37 is a capability candidate whose laser transform tracking is best-known, while its whole UX is not Human Accepted.
The Psicoanálisis PageKit surface is a distinct consumer/integration artifact and must not be silently treated as the owner of the Class Player lineage.
Do not infer Human Accepted, Current or Served state from version number, catalog liveness or a recovered file.
Agent Network owns coordination/network/**. R07 does not claim that subtree or DELTA_FEED as material scope; its one worker-status object is only the runtime-mandated independent status write.
high_value_targets: SATISFIED: capability/version/regression matrix persisted from exact durable artifacts.
SATISFIED: stable baseline, candidate gains and consumer-specific PageKit behavior separated.
SATISFIED: negative knowledge persisted for eraser safety, undo, tabs/objects, laser tracking and authority boundaries.
SATISFIED: Wacom/stylus and fullscreen claims classified by code evidence with explicit evidence ceiling.
SATISFIED: LAST_RETURN and independent worker-status cross-workstream impact persisted without mutating Agent Network-owned coordination.

Collapsing Psicoanálisis PageKit sheet tabs with V37 multi-board/object semantics.
Inferring Wacom pressure/button support from generic PointerEvent code.
Calling responsive/full-viewport layouts 'Fullscreen API' without implementation evidence.
Reintroducing hover erasure instead of pressed-only eraser semantics.
Using inaccessible historical chat claims to fill missing version history.

workers.frontier: R07 recovery is closed. Durable authority-aware capability/regression, QA and negative-knowledge evidence now separates V26 stable rollback behavior, V37 selective candidate gains and Psicoanálisis PageKit consumer/whiteboard semantics. Future work belongs to existing product owners and promotion gates.
workers.last_useful_delta: R07 proved pressed-only eraser across V26/V37/Psico, preserved V26 as the stable rollback donor, classified V37 multi-board/object plus typed-undo and laser/object behavior as selective candidate gains, rejected unsupported Wacom pressure/button and application Fullscreen claims, and kept Psico sheet semantics/consumer authority separate from Class Player lineage.

useful_delta: R07 now has a durable capability/regression matrix derived from the exact V26, V37 and Psicoanálisis PageKit artifacts plus current Lineage/Capability/Current/Catalog authority.

V26 is preserved as the stable Class Player rollback donor; V37 remains a candidate and is only a selective donor for proved gains such as laser/object interaction, multi-board/object semantics and richer typed undo.
Pressed-only eraser semantics are proved across all three inspected surfaces and are now a durable regression guard.
V26 and Psico have simple last-stroke undo behavior; V37 has typed undo for stroke add/erase/clear and object paste/delete/transform, so integrations must not silently lose that reversibility.
Generic Pointer Events do not prove Wacom pressure/buttons; no inspected implementation consumes pressure/buttons. Application Fullscreen API support is also not evidenced.
Psicoanálisis PageKit remains a consumer with multi-sheet whiteboard semantics, separate from V37 multi-board/object semantics and separate from Class Player lineage authority.
Cross-workstream impact is delivered through the runtime-mandated independent worker status instead of mutating Agent Network-owned DELTA_FEED/network coordination.
decisions: No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog, Lineage or Capability Registry authority mutation is justified by this recovery.
Do not promote V37 over V26 by version number or by the presence of advanced tools.
Keep PageKit consumer behavior, Class Player lineage, V37 board/object semantics and whiteboard sheet semantics as distinct authority domains.
V37 may donate narrowly evidenced capabilities without donating its whole UX or authority state.
Pressed-only eraser is an integration invariant for recovered behavior.
Wacom pressure/buttons and application Fullscreen API remain unproved and must not be represented as recovered capabilities.
shared_discoveries: Classes/Study integrations can consume the R07 matrix without needing historical chats: V26 is the stability donor; V37 is a selective capability donor; Psico is consumer evidence only.

Interaction integrations must preserve pressed-only eraser and reconcile reusable pointer mechanics with the existing interaction.touch-first/Focus Lease owner rather than creating a parallel global adapter.
Whiteboard integration must decide explicitly whether it wants V37 board-session/object semantics or Psico sheet semantics; they are not equivalent tab models.
A future implementation adopting V37 object/erase semantics should retain typed undo rather than copying only the visible toolbar/tools.

last_return.human_boundary: Only the existing product/authority owners and explicit Human acceptance/promotion gates can change Current, Human Accepted or Served state. R07 recovery is complete without crossing those boundaries.
last_return.next_best_action: Consume the R07 matrix at the owning PageKit/Class Player/Classes/Study integration boundary. Start from V26 for rollback stability, adopt only explicitly desired V37 gains, preserve eraser and undo guards, keep Psico sheet semantics separate, and run representative browser/input QA before any product promotion.

refresh_contract.same_epoch: Continue without reading NETWORK/DELTA; do not recompile context.
refresh_contract.new_epoch: Reload only this compiled packet; it already contains filtered relevant changes.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.

automatic_selection.explicit_exhaustive_or_existing_frozen_l: EXHAUSTIVE or CONTINUE when already frozen

Load the stable entry and current runtime manifest.
Infer the current workstream/surface from the conversation; do not ask the human to repeat recoverable context.
Prefer one compiled active Work Packet. If none matches, use Catalog surface + GENERAL.
Reconcile only new relevant branch/network deltas, not the entire repository.
Choose FAST/DEEP/EXHAUSTIVE/CONTINUE and continue the last materially unsatisfied request.
Print the violet seal only after entry + compiled packet were actually loaded this cycle.
If a Prometeo packet is active, compare the tiny EPOCH id first.
If EPOCH is unchanged, continue the current frontier immediately with no Network/Delta reread.
If EPOCH changed, reload only the active compiled Work Packet and consume its filtered relevant events.

seal.rule: Never print 🟣 P✓ unless the current stable entry and one compiled packet were successfully loaded during this work cycle.
